KS_geometry.chartFromNotebook: y = ln(sin z)/(6H): dy = cot z dx0, s^{1/3} = e^{2Hy}, cos z dx0 = e^{6Hy} dy
KS_geometry.christoffelClosedForms: Gamma^y_ii = -H g_ii, Gamma^i_yi = Gamma^i_iy = H (i = x1,x2,x3,x5,x6,x7)
KS_geometry.constantCurvatureSevenSpace: R^r_smn = -H^2 (delta^r_m g_sn - delta^r_n g_sm) on (y,x1,x2,x3,x5,x6,x7); every component with x4 vanishes

requiredSource.specNote: STAGE4_SPEC section 1 writes p_req = -15H^2/kappa; the exact mixed components give T^i_i = +15H^2/kappa on all seven transverse directions (errata E4.3); rho_req = -21H^2/kappa < 0

israelStress.convention: [K_ij] - h_ij [K] = -kappa S_ij, [X] = X(0+) - X(0-), n = +d_y, K_ij = (1/2) d_y g_ij

KS_geometry.smoothExtensionE1: W = e^{Hy} on all of R: the same y-independent curvature (regular homogeneous space)

KS_reduction.vielbeinPostulate512: postulate holds for all 512 (mu,nu,a); omega_mu ab antisymmetric
KS_reduction.gammaSlashOmega3WprimeOverW: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 (W'/W) gamma^0 (a4-independent); = 3H gamma^0 for W = e^{Hy}, -3H gamma^0 on the mirror patch W = e^{-Hy}
KS_reduction.ansatzRemoves3H: gamma^mu D_mu Psi = e^{i phi} W^{-3} [gamma^0 chi' + i kappa k gamma^1 chi - i eps gamma^4 chi], kappa = e^{-a4}/W
KS_reduction.withoutW3the3HTermSurvives: Psi = e^{i phi} chi gives the extra term +3 (W'/W) gamma^0 chi
KS_reduction.reducedEquationODEForm: chi' = gamma^0 [M_eff chi - i kappa k gamma^1 chi + i eps gamma^4 chi] (gamma^0 gamma^0 = 1)
KS_reduction.mirrorPatchKappaEven: kappa = e^{-a4} e^{H|y|} on both sides of the Z2 geometry
KS_reduction.a4IsMomentumRescaling: kappa k = e^{-Hy} (k e^{-a4}): a4 enters only as k -> k e^{-a4}
KS_reduction.JK1K2commute: J = gamma^0 gamma^1 gamma^4 (J^2 = 1, Hermitian), K1 = gamma^2 gamma^3, K2 = gamma^5 gamma^6 (squares -1) commute mutually and with A0, A1, A4, B, C
KS_reduction.A0A1A4equalsMinusJ: A0 A1 A4 = -J: the design probes / Rust label s = -j
KS_reduction.projectorsRank2: eight orthogonal Hermitian idempotents of rank 2 summing to 1

basisUnitary.note: V/(2 sqrt 2) is unitary; chi_16 = V chi_block / (2 sqrt 2)

KS_reduction.basisIsJointEigenbasis: J = j, K1 = i s2, K2 = i s3 on both basis vectors of every block
KS_reduction.blocksA0A1A4: A0 = sigma3, A1 = -i sigma2 = [[0,-1],[1,0]], A4 = j sigma1 in every block
KS_reduction.blocksBC: B = j s2, C = s2 sigma2, BC = j sigma2, gamma^4 gamma^1 = -j sigma3
KS_reduction.densityMatricesBlockForm: number 1, scalar j sigma2, y-current j sigma1 (= A4), k-current j sigma3 (= -gamma^4 gamma^1)
KS_reduction.gamma2gamma3NotBlockDiagonal: gamma^2, gamma^3 anticommute with K1: zero diagonal blocks, they map s2 -> -s2

blockTypes.yEquation: 2 inequivalent irreducible types (j = +1: blocks 0-3, j = -1: blocks 4-7)

commutantDims.method: Schur's lemma on the exact block decomposition (each block irreducible, M2(C) spanned by 1, A0, A1, A4)

KS_reduction.multiplicity: eight 2x2 blocks: 4 with j = +1 and 4 with j = -1
KS_reduction.blockODEMatrix: chi' = [M_eff sigma3 - kappa k sigma2 + i j (eps - v_v) sigma1] chi
KS_reduction.blockHamiltonianEquivalentToODE: h_j chi = eps chi with h_j = j[-i sigma1 d/dy + M_eff sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v_v is equivalent to chi' = N chi (uses j^2 = 1)
KS_reduction.hMinusEqualsMinusHPlus: h_{-1} - v_v = -(h_{+1} - v_v): the j = -1 blocks carry the negated spectrum
KS_reduction.sigma3ConjugationFlipsK: sigma3 N(k, j) sigma3 = N(-k, -j) at fixed eps: |chi|^2 and scalar density agree for (k,j), (-k,-j)
KS_reduction.degeneracy: at fixed k = (k,0,0) each level of h_{+1} is 4-fold (blocks 0-3) and each level of h_{-1} 4-fold (blocks 4-7); spec(h_{-1} - v_v) = -spec(h_{+1} - v_v); 8-fold degeneracy at k = 0 and over closed shells {k, -k} (errata E4.4)
KS_reduction.k0ZeroMode: eps = 0, chi = (e^{My}, 0): chi_2 = 0 at both ends; normalisable on (-inf, 0] for M > 0; proper density n_p ~ e^{(2M - 6H) y}
KS_reduction.k0MassiveLevels: eps = +-sqrt(M^2 + (n pi/L)^2), chi_2 = sin(n pi y/L), chi_1 = (M sin + k_n cos)/(i j eps); both signs of eps solve the same boundary problem (eps -> -eps with chi_1 -> -chi_1)

zeroModeSplitting.formula: d eps_0/dk|_{k=0} = j c, c = int_{-L}^0 kappa e^{2My} dy / int_{-L}^0 e^{2My} dy
zeroModeSplitting.note: dh/dk = j kappa sigma3 and sigma3 = +1 on the zero mode; c > 0 (positive integrand); +ck for j = +1 (Rust label s = -1), -ck for j = -1; at H = 2M the closed form is the limit c = e^{-a4} 2M L/(1 - e^{-2ML})

rotationalSymmetry.commutesWith: gamma^0, gamma^4, B, C (hence with A0, A4, the parity projectors and the theta = 0 bag)
rotationalSymmetry.consequence: the spectrum depends on |k| only; the chiral-bag condition theta != 0 rotates with k

KS_boundary.currentMatrix: B(-i C gamma^0) = gamma^0 gamma^4 = A4 = -gamma^4 gamma^0: real symmetric (B absorbed, STAGE4_SPEC section 4 corrected by errata E4.5)
KS_boundary.currentConservedAlongY: N^dagger A4 + A4 N = 0 for real M_eff, kappa, k, eps, v_v: d/dy (chi^dagger A4 chi) = 0
KS_boundary.hilbertNormNotConservedAlongY: N^dagger + N = 2 M_eff A0 - 2 i kappa k A1 != 0: chi^dagger chi is not conserved in y
KS_boundary.currentBlockForm: A4 = j sigma1: J^y_mode = j (chi_1^* chi_2 + chi_2^* chi_1) e^{-6Hy}/l^3
KS_boundary.parityKillsCurrent: chi^dagger sigma1 chi = 2 Re(chi_1^* chi_2) vanishes when either component vanishes

bagFamily.family: (1 - Q(theta)) chi(-L) = 0, Q = cos(theta) sigma3 + sin(theta) sigma2, Q^2 = 1, {Q, sigma1} = 0

KS_boundary.bagThetaZeroIsEvenParity: theta = 0: chi_2(-L) = 0, the even-parity condition at the tip (admits the k = 0 zero mode e^{My})
KS_boundary.bagIn16: Q(theta) = cos(theta) gamma^0 + i sin(theta) gamma^0 gamma^1 (chiral-bag family), Hermitian, squares to 1, anticommutes with A4; block form Q
KS_boundary.currentKilledByAnticommutingProjector: for Q chi = chi and Q Hermitian with {Q, A4} = 0: chi^dagger A4 chi = chi^dagger A4 Q chi = -chi^dagger Q A4 chi = -chi^dagger A4 chi = 0
KS_boundary.selfAdjointBoundaryTerm: phi^dagger (h chi) - (h phi)^dagger chi = -i j d/dy (phi^dagger sigma1 chi): the boundary term vanishes on any pair of current-killing conditions, so h is self-adjoint, eps real, eigenfunctions orthogonal in the flat y-measure
KS_boundary.tipAsymptotics: chi = exp(s k e^{-Hy-a4}/H) (1, i s): decays toward the tip iff s = -sgn(k); theta = -pi/2 (k > 0) selects sigma2 = -1, chi(-L) ~ (1, -i); theta = +pi/2 for k < 0
KS_boundary.parityA_symmetryIffMassOdd: -gamma^0 N(M, kappa) gamma^0 = N(-M, kappa): with kappa even, P_A maps solutions with M(y) to solutions with -M(-y); a symmetry iff M_eff is odd (the +-M mirror pair, CONTRACT errata E2)
KS_boundary.parityB_symmetryForEvenMass: P_B = i gamma^0 gamma^8 (Hermitian, squares to 1): -P_B N(M, kappa) P_B = N(M, kappa), the symmetry for an even mass function

parityB_couplesJBlocks.consequence: (1 -+ P_B) chi(0) = 0 couples block (j,s2,s3) with (-j,s2,s3): a 4x4 problem; the KS problem uses the block-diagonal P_A conditions (errata E4.6)

KS_boundary.parityOperatorsKillCurrent: gamma^0 and P_B anticommute with A4
KS_boundary.used: the KS problem uses the block-level conditions chi_2(0) = 0 / chi_1(0) = 0 (both parities as boundary conditions, not as symmetries) and the bag family at y = -L

wickTheoremHF.modes: v+, v- of block 0, v+ of block 1, v- of block 6 (B = +1, orthonormal after /sqrt 8)

KS_exchange.hartreeFockFormula: E_HF = (lambda/2)[Tr(BC rho)^2 - Tr(BC rho BC rho)] per unit volume, rho = sum_n f_n u_n u_n^dagger, with the expectation rule <Psi^dagger X Psi> = Tr(B X rho) (two-point function G = rho B)
KS_exchange.filledShellProjector: P_+(k) = (1 + h_k/E)/2, h_k = -i m gamma^4 - k gamma^4 gamma^1 Hermitian, rank 8, h P = E P

filledShellOneEighth.statement: E_x = -(lambda/2) S^2/8 = -E_H/8 for one filled shell (8 states at one k)

kernelTraceTable.h_p: m Gamma - sum_j p_j (i Gamma gamma^j) = -i m gamma^4 - gamma^4 gamma^j p_j

kernelClosedForm.kernel: Tr(P_a(p) BC P_b(q) BC) = 4[1 + a b (m^2 - p.q)/(E_p E_q)]
kernelClosedForm.note: the spin-summed |ubar_p u_q|^2 of the spec with ubar u -> u^dagger BC u

KS_exchange.blockFormOfFockTerm: Tr(BC rho BC rho) = sum_beta (n_b^2 + s_b^2 - t_b^2 - c_b^2)/2, so E_x = -(lambda/4) sum_beta (...) (errata E4.7); for the uniform gas with n_b = n/8, s_b = S/8, t_b = c_b = 0 this is (n^2 + S^2)/16

uniformGasClosedForm.e_x: -(lambda/2) Tr(BC rho BC rho) = -(lambda/32)(n^2 + S^2) for every T and every d
uniformGasClosedForm.decomposition: e_x^(v) = -(lambda/32) n^2 (number part), e_x^(s) = -(lambda/32) S^2 (scalar part)

KS_exchange.antiparticleConvention: rho = int [f_+ P_+ - f_- P_-] (normal ordering: holes of the sea): antiparticles carry negative number density (Tr P_- = 8 with weight -f_-) and positive scalar density (Tr BC P_- = -8m/E)
KS_exchange.restGasLimit: k_F -> 0: S = n, e_x = -(lambda/16) n^2 = -e_H/8 (filled-shell value)

ldaPotentials.v_v: de_x/dn|_S = -(lambda/16) n (potential type, enters as eps -> eps - v_v)
ldaPotentials.v_s: de_x/dS|_n = -(lambda/16) S (mass type, enters M_eff = m + lambda S + v_s)
ldaPotentials.used: KS-VS: M_eff = m + lambda S_p + v_s = m + (15/16) lambda S_p, v_v = -(lambda/16) n_p, the exact functional derivative of the LDA functional; KS-V uses the exact Hartree shift and v_x only

KS_exchange.couplingDimension: [Psi] = 7/2 in 8D, [m] = 1, [lambda] = mass^-6: the contact interaction beyond Hartree-Fock is not renormalisable; no correlation term; lambda-hat = lambda m^6

doubleQuadratureMpmath.method: composite Gauss-Legendre in |p|, |q| (panels around the Fermi edge; 16 vs 32 nodes per panel as the error estimate), raw kernel 4[1 + ab (m^2 - pq cos theta)/(EE')] with a 4- resp. 6-node exact angular rule (sin^2 theta for d = 4, sin theta for d = 3), mpmath 20 digits

KS_functional.stationarityGivesKSEquation: dF/dchi_n^dagger(a) = f_n w_a [h_0 chi_n + (lambda S_p + v_s)(j sigma2) chi_n + v_v chi_n](a) = f_n eps_n w_a chi_n(a): the KS equation with M_eff = m + lambda S_p + v_s, v_s = -(lambda/16) S_p, v_v = -(lambda/16) n_p; the e^{-6Hy} of the densities cancels the e^{6Hy} of dV_7 (local, flat y-measure)
KS_functional.fermiDiracOccupations: dF/df_n = eps_n + T ln(f_n/(1 - f_n)) - mu = 0 gives f_n = 1/(exp((eps_n - mu)/T) + 1)
KS_functional.totalEnergyDoubleCounting: E = sum f <h_0> + E_H + E_x = sum f eps - E_H - E_x (eps_n = <h_KS>_n on normalised orbitals); F = E - T S_ent
KS_functional.hellmannFeynmanLambda: dF/dlambda = (E_H + E_x)/lambda at the self-consistent densities
KS_functional.hellmannFeynmanMass: dF/dm = int S_p dV_7 = sum_n f_n int chi_n^dagger (j sigma2) chi_n dy
KS_functional.hellmannFeynmanMomentum: d eps_n/dk = j int kappa(y) chi_n^dagger sigma3 chi_n dy = l^3 int e^{6Hy} kappa t_n dy at fixed potentials
KS_functional.merminStructure: grand potential Omega = sum f eps - T S_ent - mu N at Fermi-Dirac occupations: dOmega/dT = -S_ent; C_V = dE/dT
KS_functional.variantV: with E_x = int dV_7 e_x(n_p, T) the stationarity gives M_eff = m + lambda S_p (no scalar exchange) and v_x = -(lambda/16)[n_p + S_u dS_u/dn] (STAGE4_SPEC recommendation KS-V)
KS_functional.definition: F[{chi_n},{f_n}] = sum f_n <chi_n|h_0|chi_n> - T S_ent[f] + E_H[S_p] + E_x[n_p, S_p], h_0 = j[-i sigma1 d/dy + m sigma2 + kappa k sigma3], dV_7 = e^{6Hy} l^3 dy, constraints int chi_n^dagger chi_n dy = 1 (eps_n), sum f_n = N (mu)
KS_functional.numericalUse: finite differences of the self-consistent F in lambda, m, T and of eps_n in k must reproduce (E_H + E_x)/lambda, int S_p dV_7, -S_ent and j int kappa t_n; with N conservation, current conservation and the double-counting identity these are the stationarity checks

staticAnticommutators.note: six of the Stage-2 21 pairs survive for a4 constant: A_{i4} = H e^{Hy+a4} gamma^0 gamma^i gamma^4, A_{4j} = H e^{Hy-a4} gamma^0 gamma^4 gamma^j

KS_emt.bilinearExtractionExact: every component is a sesquilinear form in (chi, chi^dagger) spanned by the four densities n, s, t, c (no residual)

blockIndependentForms.note: the reduced components have the same (n, s, t, c) coefficients in all 8 blocks; T^4_1 has the same coefficients of n, t and of (j s) = e^{-6Hy} chi^dagger sigma2 chi / l^3

T41form.T^4_1: c_n n + c_t t + c_js (j s), (j s) = e^{-6Hy} chi^dagger sigma2 chi / l^3
T41form.origin of c_js: the connection term A_{14} = H e^{Hy+a4} gamma^0 gamma^1 gamma^4

KS_emt.T41cancelsOverShell: T^4_1 is odd under (k,j,chi) -> (-k,-j,sigma3 chi) at the same eps (n, s invariant, t and (j s) flip): it cancels over every closed shell {k,-k} x 8 blocks
KS_emt.restStateDust: eps = M_eff = m, s = n, k = 0, v_v = 0: rho = m n, p_y = p_(i) = 0 (dust)
KS_emt.interactionPart: <U> = e_H + e_x = (lambda/2) S_p^2 - (lambda/32)(n_p^2 + S_p^2) enters rho with + and every p_(i) with - (all seven transverse directions); L_s = sum f L_s^(1) - <U>

ksState.rho: sum_n f_n [eps_n n_n - (M_eff - m) s_n - v_v n_n] + e_H + e_x
ksState.p_y: sum_n f_n [eps_n n_n - m s_n - kappa k_n t_n] - e_H - e_x
ksState.p_3: sum_n f_n [(1/3) kappa k_n t_n + (M_eff - m) s_n + v_v n_n] - e_H - e_x (shell average)
ksState.p_t: sum_n f_n [(M_eff - m) s_n + v_v n_n] - e_H - e_x

densityParityTable.P_A: n even, s odd, t even, c odd; with the mirror mass -m (M_eff - m odd) rho, p_y, p_(i) are even
densityParityTable.P_B: n, s, t even, c odd
densityParityTable.sectors: even-parity orbitals carry n(0) = |chi_1(0)|^2 and s(0) = t(0) = 0 on the brane; odd-parity orbitals n(0) = |chi_2(0)|^2, s(0) = t(0) = 0

KS_emt.properVolumeAverage: <X> = int_{-L}^0 X e^{6Hy} dy / int_{-L}^0 e^{6Hy} dy, int e^{6Hy} dy = (1 - e^{-6HL})/(6H); brane-localised fraction int_{-delta}^0 n_p e^{6Hy} dy / int_{-L}^0 n_p e^{6Hy} dy

requiredSourceComparison.ksState: rho = sum f (eps - v_v) n - (lambda/2) S_p^2 - v_s S_p + e_x >= 0 for positive-energy occupations at weak coupling: the mismatch is at least |rho_req| + rho_KS
requiredSourceComparison.E4.1 static conditions: m S = -36 H^2/kappa and lambda S^2 = 30 H^2/kappa: lambda > 0 and m S < 0
requiredSourceComparison.signOfS: the uniform gas has S = 8 int (m/E)(f_+ + f_-) > 0 for m > 0, so the sourcing solutions need m < 0 (the gamma^8 image m -> -m, lambda -> -lambda of a positive-mass state has S -> -S, CONTRACT errata E2); the numerics must report the sign of S_p and the ratios to the source

KS_agreesWithWolfram.braneStress: same sign convention and the same S^i_j = -(10,10,10,12,10,10,10) H/kappa
KS_agreesWithWolfram.basisVectorsIdentical: v+, v- of every block identical (same seed rule)
KS_agreesWithWolfram.exchangeClosedForm: the p.q term averages to zero for isotropic occupations, so the double quadrature collapses EXACTLY: e_x(n, S) = -(lambd

conventions.J: gamma^0 gamma^1 gamma^4 on both sides (Rust/probe label s = -j)
conventions.basisRule: v+ = 8 P (1 + gamma^0)/2 e_c, first c with nonzero image; v- = gamma^0 gamma^1 v+
